articles.title: No UP govt jobs for those involved in violent activities seeking ‘regime change’
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has updated its character verification rules for selected candidates in direct recruitment. Candidates involved in violent activities aiming for regime change could be denied government jobs. However, political ideology alone cannot disqualify individuals from employment. The mere registration of an FIR or ongoing investigations will not automatically make candidates ineligible. Decisions on eligibility will depend on specific circumstances related to the verification rules.

articles.title: Kerala Judge named accused in son’s fatal Mercedes crash gets anticipatory bail
articles.description: The Kerala High Court provided interim protection from arrest to an additional district judge involved in a fatal accident. His 17-year-old son allegedly drove a car during the incident in Kochi. The police interrogated the judge for several hours before issuing further notice for questioning. The judges' conduct has been questioned, leading the victim's family to seek an inquiry.

articles.description: In a landmark decision, a Michigan court has affirmed a nearly $9.7 million ruling against Henry Ford Macomb Hospital for negligence that led to Cathleen Allen's tragic death after cosmetic surgery complications. Medical testimony highlighted that prompt action could have preserved her life. The jury attributed liability to both the surgeon and hospital, underscoring the urgent need for stringent patient safety measures.

articles.title: Summerhouse Use Under Review: Jason Statham seeks lawful status for guest annexe; 1973 rule under scrutiny
articles.description: Jason Statham and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley are facing challenges in planning the summerhouse at their Hampshire estate. They have submitted a request for a certificate of lawfulness to transform the structure, initially approved as a swimming-pool pavilion, into residential quarters. Although the summerhouse has served as guest accommodation for prior owners since 2012, the New Forest National Park Authority is currently assessing the appropriateness of their application.

articles.title: Australian couple postpone wedding to build dream castle; 22 years later, it remains unfinished
articles.description: An Australian couple who postponed their wedding to build a fairytale castle in Tasmania are still working on it 22 years later. Christina Kent and Francis Shepherd have used around 100,000 bricks to construct the 27-room Castle Phoenix, which stands 17 metres tall. Despite financial and health challenges, only three of its eight turrets are complete, and their wedding remains on hold.

articles.title: Rupee gains 11 paise to 95.17 against dollar after Fed holds interest rates
articles.description: In early trading on Thursday, the rupee gained 11 paise against the US dollar, reaching 95.17. This uptick followed the US Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates steady, causing a weakening of the dollar as traders reacted negatively. Observers are now focused on upcoming economic data, especially regarding inflation and potential rate adjustments. Notably, Foreign Institutional Investors have been actively purchasing Indian equities, reflecting a positive market outlook.

articles.title: IBPS recruitment 2026: Applications open for server administrator, assistant and programming assistant posts
articles.description: IBPS recruitment 2026: IBPS has opened applications for Server Administrator, Assistant and Programming Assistant positions at its Mumbai office under Advertisement No. IBPS/2026-27/06. Applications are accepted from October 29 to November 12, 2026. Candidates need relevant educational qualifications and two or three years of post-qualification experience, depending on the role. Monthly remuneration ranges from approximately Rs. 54,210 to Rs. 73,020. Selection involves shortlisting, document verification, an online examination and a personal interview. The total vacancy count has not been specified.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu declares holiday on November 9 for schools, colleges and government offices
articles.description: Tamil Nadu holiday November 9: The Tamil Nadu government has declared November 9 a holiday for government offices, public sector undertakings, schools, colleges and educational institutions across the state. The decision follows requests from students, parents, teachers and government employees travelling home for Deepavali on November 8. November 28 will be a working day to compensate for the additional holiday. As the closure does not fall under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, district collectors must ensure treasuries and sub-treasuries remain operational with essential staff.

articles.title: Karnataka schools directed to celebrate Kannada Rajyotsava on November 1 despite Sunday holiday
articles.description: Kannada Rajyotsava 2026: The Karnataka School Education and Literacy Department has directed all government, aided and unaided primary and high schools to celebrate Kannada Rajyotsava on November 1, 2026, despite the date falling on a Sunday. An October 15 circular instructs schools to observe state and national festivals on their designated dates without postponement due to holidays. Education Minister Madhu Bangarappa reiterated the directive, while some school authorities raised concerns about parental participation and teachers' weekly holiday.

articles.title: Karnataka proposes ban on coaching for under-15s, caps daily classes at five hours
articles.description: Karnataka has proposed draft rules to regulate private coaching centres, barring students under 15 or those who have not completed Class 10 from enrolling. The rules cap daily coaching at five hours, restrict operating hours to 6 am-9 pm and prohibit classes during school or college hours. They also mandate mental health counsellors, confidential assessment results, tutor training and career guidance. The draft aims to curb academic stress, misleading advertisements and fee-related concerns across the state.
